text_blocks.snippet: Pneumonitis symptoms can vary depending on the cause and severity, but common signs include shortness of breath, cough, fever, fatigue, and chest pain. Some individuals may also experience chills, muscle aches, and even wheezing. In more severe cases, or when pneumonitis becomes chronic, symptoms can progress to include persistent dry cough, chest discomfort, clubbing of the fingers, and lower oxygen levels.
